outcome_description: ln(1 + number of cadaveric kidneys shared between the two airports' service areas)
notes: Origin-destination airport-pair x year panel 2002-2017, balanced. pair_id = integer code of OrgDestAirport (unit FE and cluster, as vce(cl OrgDestAirport)). gyear = EventYear for treated pairs (treatment_pair==1), NA for never-treated control pairs; D = 1[year >= gyear] equals the authors' TreatmentAfter on every row (checked). Treatment is absorbing (no switch-offs). The 2002 cohort is treated in the first panel year (always-treated): kept in TWFE/BJS samples as in the authors' regression; did::att_gt drops it. Authors' line 208: reg LnOrganVolume TreatmentAfter TxYear* ODPair* if airport_dist >= 800, vce(cl OrgDestAirport). fixest: 0.0737326 (0.0303393 with Stata reg dof; 0.0293758 fixest default), N 9,184, adj. R2 0.0616. Published 0.073 (0.030), N 9,184, adj. R2 0.062; the printed coefficient looks truncated rather than rounded (abstract: 7.3%). Sample: 574 pairs (61 treated, 513 never treated); cohorts 2002:7, 2003:2, 2004:1, 2005:8, 2006:2, 2008:2, 2012:8, 2013:6, 2014:8, 2015:13, 2016:2, 2017:2. Expected run_spec TWFE = 0.0737326 / 0.2469761 (population SD) = 0.29854.
